/-!
# Hilbert's Fifth Problem

The actual formalization is in `FormalConjectures.HilbertProblems.«5»`.

Hilbert's fifth problem asks whether every locally Euclidean topological group admits a Lie group
structure. This was resolved affirmatively by Gleason, Montgomery, and Zippin in 1952.

*References:*
- [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hilbert%27s_fifth_problem)
- [Gleason 1952](https://doi.org/10.2307/1969548)
- [Montgomery–Zippin 1952](https://doi.org/10.2307/1969549)
- [Tao's blog](https://terrytao.wordpress.com/2011/08/13/the-hilbert-smith-conjecture/)
-/

findings.description: The reference labelled “Gleason 1952” on line 30 has the wrong DOI. `10.2307/1969548` identifies Kenkichi Iwasawa's 1949 paper, not Gleason's 1952 paper. This is a bibliographic error; the module's mathematical summary remains correct.
findings.source_evidence: Crossref's record at https://api.crossref.org/works/10.2307/1969548 identifies “On Some Types of Topological Groups,” Kenkichi Iwasawa, July 1949. The record at https://api.crossref.org/works/10.2307/1969795 identifies the intended “Groups Without Small Subgroups,” Andrew M. Gleason, September 1952, Annals of Mathematics 56(2).

findings.description: The reference labelled “Montgomery–Zippin 1952” on line 31 has the wrong DOI. `10.2307/1969549` identifies a 1949 paper by Erling Følner, not the intended Montgomery–Zippin paper. This does not change the mathematical statement or its solved status.
findings.source_evidence: Crossref's record at https://api.crossref.org/works/10.2307/1969549 identifies “A Proof of the Main Theorem for Almost Periodic Functions in an Abelian Group,” Erling Folner, July 1949. The record at https://api.crossref.org/works/10.2307/1969796 identifies “Small Subgroups of Finite-Dimensional Groups,” Deane Montgomery and Leo Zippin, September 1952, Annals of Mathematics 56(2).
